Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The sentence on what to do first after a crash starts at the foot of the first selected page and ends on the second; it is taught from the second page [A02].
The law enforcement section on the second selected page carries its own revision line, which differs from the manual's contents-page revision; the section is taught as printed and its revision line is not used for edition currency [A02].
The extracted text of the traffic stop pages is broken mid-word in many places; each step is taught from its readable meaning only [A03].
The last selected page offers a QR code for a safety video and a list of ADOT website topics; the video and website were not viewed and only the page's own words are taught [A04].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.
